notes: Total 60 with the poster's own correction below the list: 'The other 4 effects are Visage of the Emperor x4 and there are supposed to be 2 Vader's Saber.' The Effects header says 14 with 10 listed, so Visage Of The Emperor x4 is added and Vader's Lightsaber is 2 (posted list alone: 55).
Starting: the strategy says 'Start Imperial Arrest Order vs. most all decks' (Crush The Rebellion first vs. Throne Room), so Imperial Arrest Order is the starting Effect.

Posted 'Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi' dested the two-sided objective; 'Executor Holotheater' Executor: Holotheatre; 'Death Star Docking Bay' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Cloud City Docking Bay' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'IG-88 with Gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Mara Jade, TEH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Blast Door Control' Blast Door Controls.
Same-name existing page Adam Beauchamp (2011 World Championship player) used; no confirmed link to this 2000 DeckTech handle.
Battle Order, Resistance, Secret Plans, Oppressive Enforcement and Come Here You Big Coward (where listed) are the pre-Reflections III Effects (no Defensive Shields in 2000).
